cards.title: T-KAN模型提升高频限价订单簿预测性能与可解释性
cards.titleEn: T-KAN Model Enhances High-Frequency Limit Order Book Forecasting Performance and Interpretability
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research addresses alpha decay in high-frequency trading by proposing a KAN-based model that is both interpretable and efficient, potentially providing insights while enabling low-latency deployment.
keyPoints: 提出T-KAN架构，用B样条激活函数替代LSTM线性权重
在FI-2010数据集上，T-KAN在k=100时F1分数相对提升19.1%
模拟交易中T-KAN收益132.48%，DeepLOB回撤-82.76%（成本1.0 bps）
T-KAN解释性强，通过样条可观察到“死区”
架构优化用于FPGA低延迟实现
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究针对高频交易中预测时效衰减问题，提出一种基于KAN的可解释且高效的模型，有望在保留预测能力的同时提供洞见，并为低延迟部署提供可能。
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN), replacing standard LSTM fixed linear weights with learnable B-spline activation functions to better capture nonlinear patterns in high-frequency limit order book data and mitigate alpha decay. On the FI-2010 dataset, the model achieves a 19.1% relative F1 score improvement at k=100, outperforming DeepLOB in backtests and supporting FPGA implementation.
cards.description: 该研究提出时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN），将标准LSTM的固定线性权重替换为可学习的B样条激活函数，以更好地捕捉高频限价订单簿数据中的非线性模式，并缓解预测时效（alpha decay）问题。该模型在FI-2010数据集上，在k=100时间尺度下，F1分数相对提升19.1%，且在模拟交易中表现优于DeepLOB，同时支持FPGA高效实现。
cards.limitations: 本研究基于单一数据集（FI-2010），结果可能不具有普适性；模拟交易结果未考虑实际滑点、市场冲击等因素；与DeepLOB的比较可能受实验设置影响；论文未经同行评审，结论需谨慎对待。
cards.summaryEn: The author leverages the FI-2010 dataset to propose T-KAN architecture for improved accuracy and interpretability in high-frequency LOB forecasting. Key findings: T-KAN achieves 19.1% relative F1 improvement at k=100, and in simulated trading with 1.0 bps transaction costs, yields 132.48% return versus DeepLOB's -82.76% drawdown. The author argues T-KAN is superior, interpretable, and suitable for low-latency hardware.
cards.limitationsEn: This study is based on a single dataset (FI-2010), so results may not generalize. Simulated trading ignores real-world considerations like slippage and market impact. Comparisons with DeepLOB may be influenced by experimental setups. The paper is not peer-reviewed, so conclusions should be treated with caution.
cards.summary: 研究内容：作者利用FI-2010数据集，引入T-KAN模型架构，旨在改善高频订单簿预测的准确性与解释性。主要发现：T-KAN在k=100时F1分数相对提升19.1%，在扣除10个基点交易成本后，策略收益132.48%，而DeepLOB回撤-82.76%。作者观点：认为T-KAN优于传统模型，解释性强，且适合低延迟硬件实现。
cards.originalTitle: Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN) for High-Frequency Limit Order Book Forecasting: Efficiency, Interpretability, and Alpha Decay
keyPointsEn: Proposes T-KAN architecture using B-spline activations instead of LSTM linear weights
On FI-2010, T-KAN improves F1 by 19.1% relative at k=100
Simulated trading: T-KAN return 132.48%, DeepLOB drawdown -82.76% (cost 1.0 bps)
T-KAN is interpretable, with visible dead zones in splines
Architecture optimized for FPGA low-latency implementation

cards.title: Alpha-R1：利用强化学习提升量化因子筛选的语义对齐能力
cards.titleEn: Alpha-R1: Enhancing Quantitative Factor Screening with Semantic Alignment via Reinforcement Learning
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research introduces LLM semantic reasoning into quantitative factor screening, offering a new approach to address signal decay and regime shifts in non-stationary markets. The semantic gating mechanism may help strategies adapt flexibly to market changes, but requires caution due to complexity and limited evaluation.
keyPoints: Alpha-R1利用强化学习优化大语言模型的因子筛选策略，通过语义门控动态匹配市场状态与因子经济逻辑。
采用GRPO算法训练模型，以投资组合回报作为主要奖励信号，在有限候选池内进行样本外评估。
在标普500和CSI 300上分别实现47.87%和40.57%的年化收益率，夏普比率1.62和2.23。
框架强调从经济语义角度理解因子适用性，突破传统纯数值时间序列分析的局限。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究将大语言模型的语义理解能力引入量化因子筛选，为处理非平稳市场中的信号衰减和体制转换问题提供新方法。其“语义门控”机制或能帮助投资策略更灵活适应市场变化，但需注意其复杂性和有限评估条件。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper introduces Alpha-R1, a framework combining large language models with reinforcement learning for quantitative factor screening. It innovates by incorporating a 'semantic gating' mechanism that evaluates factors' economic rationale against dynamic market states, addressing the limitation of traditional methods that ignore semantic context. The framework shows promising out-of-sample performance on S&P 500 and CSI 300, offering novel insights for quantitative researc
cards.description: 本研究提出Alpha-R1框架，将大语言模型与强化学习结合，用于量化因子筛选。其创新点在于引入“语义门控”机制，通过动态市场状态描述评估因子的经济合理性，以解决传统方法忽略因子语义背景的问题，从而提高因子有效性。该框架在标普500和沪深300指数上展示出优于传统方法的样本外表现，为量化研究提供了新的思路。
cards.limitations: 评估局限于有限候选池（specific pools），可能高估实际表现；样本外仅12个月，未覆盖完整市场周期；结果依赖于特定参数和初始条件，未知其对不同市场或交易成本的稳健性。
cards.summaryEn: The research presents Alpha-R1, which uses reinforcement learning to train an LLM to semantically filter candidate factors based on market conditions. In a 12-month out-of-sample test, it reports annualized returns of 47.87% for S&P 500 and 40.57% for CSI 300, with Sharpe ratios of 1.62 and 2.23, respectively. The authors interpret these results as evidence supporting second-stage semantic factor reranking.
cards.limitationsEn: The evaluation is limited to specific bounded pools, which may overstate real-world performance. The out-of-sample period is only 12 months, not covering full market cycles. Results are sensitive to parameter choices and may not generalize across different markets or after trading costs.
cards.summary: 研究介绍了一个名为Alpha-R1的框架，其核心是使用强化学习训练大语言模型，根据市场状态对候选因子进行语义筛选。在12个月的样本外测试中，报告了年化收益47.87%（标普500）和40.57%（沪深300），夏普比率分别为1.62和2.23。作者认为这些结果证明了语义因子重排序的有效性。
cards.originalTitle: Alpha-R1: Alpha Screening with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
keyPointsEn: Alpha-R1 uses reinforcement learning to optimize LLM-based factor screening, dynamically aligning market states with factor economic logic via semantic gating.
Trained with GRPO using portfolio returns as primary reward, evaluated out-of-sample within a bounded candidate pool.
Achieves 47.87% annualized return on S&P 500 and 40.57% on CSI 300, with Sharpe ratios of 1.62 and 2.23.
Emphasizes understanding factors from economic semantics, overcoming pure numerical time-series analysis limitations.

cards.title: 简单动态股票/债券/黄金组合：波动率控制与凸优化的改进
cards.titleEn: Simple Dynamic Stock/Bond/Gold Portfolios: Improvement via Volatility Control and Convex Optimization
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research provides investors with simple dynamic portfolio strategies based on public data and standard quantitative methods, capable of improving risk-return profiles over the long run without complex models or proprietary data. It is relevant for both individual and institutional investors.
keyPoints: 传统的60/40或50/30/20组合可作为改进基准
简单的波动率控制策略（动态混合现金）能改善风险调整后收益和回撤
基于凸优化的动态组合（利用简单回报预测或经济数据预测）进一步提升表现
文中方法优于风险平价和最小方差等标准风险配置方法
所有方法仅使用公开数据和标准量化金融工具
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为投资者提供了一种基于公开数据和标准量化方法的简单动态组合策略，能够在长期中改善投资组合的风险收益特征，而无需复杂的模型或专有数据。这对个人投资者和机构投资者都具有参考价值。
cards.descriptionEn: This study evaluates simple dynamic strategies for improving over traditional fixed-weight portfolios using public data. During 2006-2026, volatility control and convex optimization methods improved risk-adjusted returns and drawdowns. The methods require only simple estimates and standard quantitative tools, offering practical improvement for individual and institutional investors.
cards.description: 本研究基于公开数据，评估了超过传统固定权重组合的简单动态策略。通过波动率控制和基于凸优化的方法，在2006-2026年期间，风险调整后收益和回撤指标均有显著改善。该方法仅需简单估计和标准量化工具，无需复杂数据或模型，为个人投资者和机构提供了实用的投资组合改进方案。
cards.limitations: 研究基于2006-2026年的特定样本期，结果可能受到市场环境的影响；交易成本为保守估计，实际成本可能变化；波动率控制和预测方法基于历史数据，未来可能失效；黄金作为替代品和通胀对冲的表现受特定时期影响。
cards.summaryEn: The paper investigates simple methods to improve traditional fixed-weight stock/bond/gold portfolios. Using volatility control (mixing the fixed-weight portfolio with cash to target a volatility) and convex optimization-based dynamic portfolios (with simple return forecasts or economic data forecasts), they show superior performance in Sharpe ratio and drawdown over benchmarks and standard methods like risk parity, during 2006-2026. The authors rely on public data and standard tools, but acknowledge limitations including limited sample period and conservative cost estimates.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on a specific sample period from 2006 to 2026, and results may be influenced by market conditions; trading costs are conservatively estimated and actual costs may vary; volatility control and forecasting methods rely on historical data and may fail in the future; gold's performance as an alternative and inflation hedge is subject to period-specific effects.
cards.summary: 该论文探讨了通过简单方法改进传统股票/债券/黄金固定权重组合的可行性。作者使用波动率控制策略（将固定权重组合与现金混合以目标波动率）以及基于凸优化的动态组合（包含简单回报预测和经济数据预测），在2006-2026年样本期内，相比基准和风险平价等标准方法，这些动态组合在夏普比率、回撤等指标上表现更优。作者指出，该方法利用公开数据和标准量化金融工具，但存在样本期有限、交易成本估计保守等局限。
keyPointsEn: Traditional 60/40 or 50/30/20 portfolios serve as improvement benchmarks
Simple volatility control (dynamically mixing with cash) improves risk-adjusted returns and drawdowns
Convex optimization-based dynamic portfolios (using simple return or economic forecasts) further enhance performance
The proposed methods outperform standard risk-based allocation like risk parity and minimum variance
All methods use only public data and standard quantitative finance tools

cards.title: 混合线性与非线性神经网络提升电价预测精度与效率
cards.titleEn: Hybrid Linear and Neural Network Models Enhance Electricity Price Forecasting Accuracy and Efficiency
cards.whyItMattersEn: Accurate yet efficient forecasting is crucial for power market operations; this approach offers a scalable solution that reduces computational overhead without compromising precision, relevant for real-time or large-scale applications.
keyPoints: 提出多变量混合神经网络，融合线性和非线性结构以捕捉电价中的复杂关系
创新部分在线学习策略，结合warm-starting与分阶段超参数配置，显著降低计算时间
集成伯恩斯坦在线聚合（BOA）进行预测组合，进一步提升精度
在主要欧洲电力市场六年数据上验证，RMSE降低11-12%，MAE降低14-17%
cards.whyItMatters: 电力市场预测对投资组合管理和电力调度至关重要，该方法在保证精度的同时显著降低计算成本，适用于高频或大规模预测场景，为电价预测提供更高效的解决方案。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a multivariate hybrid neural network combining linear and nonlinear structures, a novel partial online learning strategy for computational efficiency, and Bernstein Online Aggregation for accuracy, yielding 11-12% RMSE and 14-17% MAE reductions in day-ahead forecasting.
cards.description: 本研究提出一种多变量混合神经网络架构，结合线性与非线性前馈结构，并引入部分在线学习策略与伯恩斯坦在线聚合，在降低计算成本的同时提高日前电价预测精度，较现有方法RMSE降低11-12%，MAE降低14-17%。
cards.limitations: 该研究基于特定欧洲市场和六年数据，结果可能不适用于其他市场或时期；具体数据集和基准实现未在摘要中详尽描述；部分在线学习策略和BOA组合的优势依赖超参数配置，泛化性需进一步验证。
cards.summaryEn: The study develops a hybrid model blending linear and nonlinear feed-forward networks, integrates partial online learning with warm-starting and stage-specific hyperparameters to cut computational costs, and applies Bernstein Online Aggregation for forecast combination. Tested on six years of European market data, it outperforms benchmarks in both accuracy and computational efficiency, with the authors identifying the online learning strategy as a key contribution.
cards.limitationsEn: Results derive from specific European markets and a six-year period, and may not generalize to other contexts; details of the dataset and benchmark implementations are not fully disclosed; model performance may rely on careful hyperparameter tuning and the benefits of partial online learning require broader validation.
cards.summary: 该研究针对欧洲主要电力市场，提出混合线性与非线性神经网络模型，通过部分在线学习策略（warm-starting和分阶段超参数配置）减少计算时间，并结合伯恩斯坦在线聚合进行预测组合。实验基于六年数据，结果显示所提方法在预测精度和计算效率上均优于对比的基准模型。作者认为该策略是主要贡献。
cards.originalTitle: Electricity Price Forecasting: Bridging Linear Models, Neural Networks and Online Learning
keyPointsEn: Proposes a multivariate hybrid neural network integrating linear and nonlinear layers to capture complex price dynamics
Introduces a partial online learning strategy with warm-starting and distinct hyperparameters per stage, greatly reducing computation time
Incorporates Bernstein Online Aggregation (BOA) for forecast combination to improve accuracy
Validates on six years of European data, achieving RMSE reductions of 11-12% and MAE reductions of 14-17%

cards.title: 医疗流程RPA机会识别与优先级排序的数据驱动框架
cards.titleEn: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework provides a structured method to address the high failure rate of RPA projects by offering a repeatable process for screening, prioritizing, and selecting automation opportunities, considering financial returns and risks, thus enabling hospitals to allocate resources more effectively and reduce administrative burden.
keyPoints: 提出四模块框架：流程分类法、优先级排序、工具层级选择、投资回报模块
流程分类法涵盖五个价值流中的二十个常见医院流程
优先级排序使用层次分析法，包含一致性检查，生成自动化适宜性指数
工具层级选择推荐成本最低的足够满足流程复杂度、集成和合规要求的技术
投资回报模块量化劳动力节省、错误成本规避、回收期和净现值
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架为解决RPA项目失败率高的问题提供了结构化的方法，通过可重复的流程来筛选、排序和选择自动化机会，并考虑财务回报和风险，从而帮助医院更有效地配置资源并减少行政负担。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a four-module framework to systematically identify, prioritize, and match robotic process automation opportunities in healthcare processes, addressing the lack of structure and financial evaluation in existing methods.
cards.description: 该研究提出一个四模块框架，用于系统性地识别、优先级排序和匹配医疗流程中的机器人流程自动化机会，解决现有方法缺乏结构化和财务评估的问题。
cards.limitations: 该框架是文献的概念综合，而非基于医院原始数据校准的工具；其流程分类法、权重和财务参数基于文献或假设，实际应用时需进行调整和验证；需要讨论HIPAA合规要求；框架的有效性需要进一步的实证验证。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes a data-driven framework for identifying and prioritizing robotic process automation opportunities in hospital settings. The framework includes a process taxonomy, prioritization module, tool-tier selection module, and ROI module. Applied to a synthetic portfolio, the authors demonstrate feasibility, but emphasize that it is a conceptual synthesis rather than empirical calibration.
cards.limitationsEn: The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature, not an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; its process taxonomy, weights, and financial parameters are based on literature or assumptions, requiring adjustment and validation for practical application; HIPAA compliance needs to be discussed; the effectiveness of the framework requires further empirical validation.
cards.summary: 该论文提出一个数据驱动的框架，用于在医院环境中识别和优先考虑机器人流程自动化机会。框架包括流程分类法、优先级排序模块、工具层级选择模块和投资回报模块。通过对合成投资组合的应用，作者展示了框架的可行性，但强调其作为概念综合而非实证校准。
cards.originalTitle: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
keyPointsEn: Proposes a four-module framework: process taxonomy, prioritization, tool-tier selection, and ROI modules
Process taxonomy covers twenty common hospital processes across five value streams
Prioritization uses analytic hierarchy process with consistency check, deriving an automation suitability index
Tool-tier selection recommends least-cost technology sufficient for complexity, integration, and compliance profile
ROI module quantifies labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value

cards.title: 几何感知残差修正：提升SABR模型隐含波动率近似精度
cards.titleEn: Geometry-Aware Residual Correction of Hagan's SABR Implied Volatility Formula
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers an interpretable correction to analytical approximations in derivatives pricing, balancing accuracy and efficiency, with practical value for real-time risk management and calibration in trading.
keyPoints: 提出混合方法：解析公式+机器学习残差修正。
引入几何特征作为神经网络输入，增强模型对SABR动力学的表示。
训练网络学习Hagan公式的残差，而非直接拟合隐含波动率。
在常规参数域和极端场景下，相比解析近似和标准神经网络，精度和稳健性提升。
方法轻量，保持可解释性，适用于实时定价与校准。
cards.whyItMatters: 为金融衍生品定价中解析近似的局限性提供了一种可解释的修正方案，兼顾精度与效率，对交易环境中的实时风险管理和校准具有实用价值。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper proposes a hybrid method combining analytical formulas with machine learning, using geometric features and residual learning to improve Hagan's approximation accuracy for SABR implied volatility. Its novelty lies in leveraging the geometry of SABR dynamics to enhance neural network inputs and learning residuals instead of direct volatility, balancing interpretability and accuracy for real-time pricing and calibration.
cards.description: 本文提出一种混合方法，将解析公式与机器学习结合，通过引入几何特征和残差学习，改进Hagan近似公式在SABR模型隐含波动率上的精度。新在利用SABR动力学的几何属性增强神经网络输入，并学习残差而非直接预测波动率，兼顾可解释性与准确性，适用于实时定价与校准。
cards.limitations: 局限性包括：数值实验可能仅限于部分参数范围，未涵盖所有极端条件；机器学习模型的泛化能力依赖于训练数据的代表性；残差修正的有效性高度依赖于Hagan公式的基线准确性，且未在真实市场数据上验证；实际部署时可能存在过拟合风险。
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a hybrid framework that retains Hagan's analytical formula as a baseline and uses neural networks to learn its residuals. Network inputs include geometry-aware features. Numerical experiments show improved accuracy and robustness over pure analytical or pure neural approaches under normal and stressed market conditions. The authors argue the method is lightweight, structurally consistent, and suitable for real-time trading environments.
cards.limitationsEn: Limitations include: numerical experiments may be restricted to certain parameter ranges, not covering all extreme conditions; generalization of the machine learning model depends on representative training data; the effectiveness of residual correction relies heavily on the accuracy of Hagan's baseline formula; no validation on real market data; there is potential overfitting risk in practical deployment.
cards.summary: 作者提出一种混合框架：保留Hagan解析公式作为基础，使用神经网络学习其残差。网络输入包含几何感知变量。数值实验显示在常规和压力市场下，该方法比纯解析或纯神经网络更准确、稳健。作者认为该方法轻量且结构一致，适合实时交易环境。
cards.originalTitle: A Geometry-Aware Residual Correction of Hagan's SABR Implied Volatility Formula
keyPointsEn: Proposes a hybrid method: analytical formula plus machine-learned residual correction.
Introduces geometric features as neural network inputs to better represent SABR dynamics.
Trains the network to learn residuals of Hagan's formula, not implied volatility directly.
Shows improved accuracy and robustness versus analytical approximations and standard neural networks under realistic and stressed parameter domains.
Method is lightweight, retains interpretability, and suits real-time pricing and calibration.

cards.title: 基于可微代理模型的分期神经优化实现预布局信号完整性设计空间探索加速
cards.titleEn: Accelerating Pre-Layout Signal Integrity DSE via Amortized Neural Optimization with Differentiable Surrogates
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers a new path to overcome computational bottlenecks in high-speed signal integrity design, allowing designers to explore the design space in real-time, thus shortening product development cycles. The amortized optimization idea may generalize to other engineering optimization problems with expensive simulations.
keyPoints: ANO采用完全可微的神经网络代理模型，从中提取梯度信息以训练全局优化策略，避免了推理时的迭代黑盒搜索。
训练后的ANO策略能将不同通道上下文映射到近最优设计参数，仅需一次确定性前向传播。
在三个SI设计场景（DDR5 DFE、SerDes Tx/Rx协同均衡、DDR3 DQS差分对）中验证，相对实例特定黑盒算法牺牲约10%最优性，但获得3~4个数量级加速。
针对32万实例的多角点SerDes扫描，ANO将原本需数天的迭代计算缩短至毫秒级批处理。
该方法将计算密集的SI优化转化为实时交互式预布局设计空间探索。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为高速信号完整性设计中的计算瓶颈提供了新路径，使设计人员能够实时探索设计空间，大幅缩短产品开发周期。ANO的学习式优化思想可推广至其他依赖昂贵模拟的工程优化问题。
cards.descriptionEn: The paper introduces Amortized Neural Optimization (ANO) to speed up pre-layout signal integrity (SI) design space exploration by training a global optimization policy offline that can output near-optimal design parameters in one forward pass. This replaces slow iterative black-box optimization, reducing multi-corner sweeps from days to milliseconds, enabling real-time interactive DSE.
cards.description: 该研究提出“分期神经优化”（ANO）方法，将昂贵的迭代优化过程离线训练为全局策略，使得在推理时只需一次前向传播即可获得近最优设计参数，从而将预布局信号完整性（SI）设计空间探索从数天缩短至毫秒级。新颖之处在于利用可微代理模型提取梯度来训练优化策略，避免了传统黑盒迭代，实现了多角点扫描的实时交互。
cards.limitations: ANO以约10%的最优性损失换取速度，意味着设计质量可能略低于传统黑盒优化。文中仅验证了特定场景，其泛化性未知。方法依赖可微代理模型，复杂物理效应可能难以准确建模，限制其适用性。该研究是预印本，未经同行评审。
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose ANO to address the high cost of simulation and optimization in pre-layout SI design. They note that ML surrogates speed up simulation but still rely on iterative black-box search. ANO learns from gradients of a differentiable surrogate to train a policy mapping channel contexts to near-optimal designs. Experiments on DDR5, SerDes, and DDR3 scenarios show ~10% optimality loss but 3-4 orders speedup, and reduce a 320k-instance sweep to milliseconds. The author argues this transforms SI optimization into real-time interactive DSE.
cards.limitationsEn: ANO trades ~10% optimality for speed, meaning design quality might be slightly inferior. Validation is limited to specific scenarios, and generalizability is unknown. The method depends on differentiable surrogates; complex physical effects may be hard to model accurately, restricting applicability. The paper is a preprint and has not been peer-reviewed.
cards.summary: 本文提出ANO框架，针对预布局SI设计中的仿真和优化成本高的问题。作者指出传统机器学习代理模型虽加速仿真，但优化仍依赖迭代黑盒搜索。ANO通过离线学习全局优化策略，在推理时映射通道上下文到近最优设计参数。基于三个SI场景（DDR5 DFE、9维SerDes协同均衡、DDR3差分对眼图优化）验证，在牺牲约10%最优性的情况下获得3至4个数量级加速，并在32万实例的SerDes扫描中将数天计算缩短至毫秒。观点：该方法将昂贵的SI优化变为实时交互式DSE。
cards.originalTitle: Amortized Neural Optimization for Pre-Layout Signal Integrity Design Space Exploration using Differentiable Surrogates
keyPointsEn: ANO uses a fully differentiable neural surrogate to obtain gradients for training a global optimization policy, avoiding iterative black-box inference.
The trained policy maps different channel contexts to near-optimal design parameters via a single deterministic forward pass.
Validated on three SI scenarios (DDR5 DFE, SerDes co-equalization, DDR3 DQS differential pair) with ~10% loss in optimality and 3-4 orders speedup.
For a 320,000-instance multi-corner SerDes sweep, ANO reduces days of computation to milliseconds.
This enables real-time interactive pre-layout design space exploration.

cards.title: 渐近信息神经网络在Black-Scholes隐含波动率计算中的应用
cards.titleEn: Asymptotically-Informed Neural Networks for Implied Volatility Calculation
cards.whyItMattersEn: Implied volatility is fundamental in finance, yet its computation is challenging under extreme parameters. This method offers high precision and efficiency, potentially improving option pricing, calibration, and risk management.
keyPoints: 提出一种渐近信息神经网络架构，用于Black-Scholes隐含波动率计算。
通过门控系统对价格-对数货币性域进行可训练划分。
利用不同波动率区域的渐近行为，在每个区域进行局部逼近。
数值实验显示比标准前馈神经网络精度提高数个数量级。
神经网络输出为三阶Householder迭代提供高质量初值，快速达到机器精度。
cards.whyItMatters: 隐含波动率在金融中广泛使用，但精确计算尤其在极端参数下具有挑战性。该方法提供了一种高精度、高效率的数值方案，有助于提高期权定价、模型校准和风险管理的可靠性。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper presents a novel neural network architecture that incorporates asymptotic information to efficiently compute Black-Scholes implied volatility. By using a gating system to partition the price-log-moneyness domain and employing specialized local approximators, the method achieves high accuracy and generalization, especially in asymptotic regimes of extreme option prices or maturities.
cards.description: 该研究提出了一种新型的渐近信息神经网络架构，用于高效计算Black-Scholes隐含波动率。该架构通过门控系统对价格-对数货币性域进行可训练划分，并在不同区域使用专门的局部逼近，显著提升了计算的精度和泛化能力，尤其在极端期权价格或期限的渐近区域表现优异。
cards.limitations: 研究主要基于Black-Scholes模型的假设，未考虑真实市场中的波动率微笑、跳跃或随机波动率等复杂因素。神经网络训练需要大量数据，且对训练集之外的参数可能泛化能力有限。本文未提供理论上的误差上界，数学性质分析不足。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes an asymptotically-informed neural network for improving numerical computation of implied volatility. The authors exploit distinct behaviors of the Black-Scholes function in different volatility regimes to design a gated architecture that partitions the domain and learns local approximations. Experiments show significant accuracy improvements over standard feed-forward networks and excellent generalization. The network outputs also provide high-quality initial guesses for a third-order Householder scheme, enabling near machine precision after two iterations.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on Black-Scholes assumptions and ignores market complexities like volatility smile, jumps, or stochastic volatility. Neural networks require substantial training data and may generalize poorly beyond the training domain. The paper lacks theoretical error bounds and rigorous mathematical analysis.
cards.summary: 本文主要介绍了一种结合渐近分析信息的神经网络方法，用于改善隐含波动率的数值计算。作者提出利用Black-Scholes定价函数在不同波动率区域的行为差异，设计了一种带有门控系统的神经网络架构，将定义域划分为多个区域，并在每个区域学习局部逼近函数。实验表明，该方法在相对精度上比标准前馈神经网络高出数个数量级，并且泛化性能良好。此外，神经网络输出为三阶Householder迭代提供了高质量初值，经过两次迭代即可达到接近机器精度。
cards.originalTitle: Asymptotically-informed neural networks for Black-Scholes implied volatility computation
keyPointsEn: Propose an asymptotically-informed neural network architecture for implied volatility computation.
Learnable partition of price-log-moneyness domain via gating functions.
Exploit asymptotic behaviors in different volatility regions for local approximation.
Outperform standard feed-forward networks by orders of magnitude in accuracy.
Network outputs seed efficient Householder iteration to machine precision.

cards.title: STQA基准：面向股票历史与预测数据的表格问答评估
cards.titleEn: STQA Benchmark: Evaluating Table Question Answering on Stock Historical and Forecasted Data
cards.whyItMattersEn: This benchmark fills the gap in evaluating forecast reasoning in financial QA, providing a testbed for developing reliable financial agents, with practical implications.
keyPoints: STQA基准涵盖4417只股票，包含31,400个问答对，由专家模板生成，并有细粒度意图和槽位标注。
问题类型包括历史查询、数值预测和预测推理，用于全面评估模型能力。
SQFRS系统整合SQL检索和预测工具，但实验显示预测推理是大语言模型的短板。
揭示了工具协同和不确定性推理的瓶颈，为未来研究提供方向。
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准填补了金融问答中预测推理评估的空白，为开发可靠的金融智能体提供测试和比较的平台，具有实践意义。
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces STQA, a benchmark for systematic evaluation of natural language QA over historical stock data, numerical forecasts, and forecast-based reasoning, addressing the fragmentation in existing financial QA benchmarks. It provides a unified testbed for financial LLMs and agents, with emphasis on the challenging reasoning from forecasts.
cards.description: 该研究提出STQA基准，用于系统评估自然语言问答在历史数据、数值预测及基于预测推理上的表现，填补了现有金融问答基准碎片化的空白。其价值在于为金融领域大语言模型和智能体提供统一测试平台，尤其关注预测推理这一难点。
cards.limitations: 基准依赖模板生成，可能限制自然语言多样性；数据虽大但特定于股票领域，通用性有限。实验评估在文章范围内，但尚未全面验证真实场景中的泛化能力。
cards.summaryEn: The paper presents STQA, a stock-focused tabular QA benchmark built on a large financial dataset covering 4,417 stocks with 31,400 QA pairs derived from expert templates with fine-grained intent and slot annotations. They propose SQFRS, an agent-based framework that orchestrates SQL retrieval and time-series forecasting tools. Experiments show that current LLMs perform well on historical queries but struggle with forecast-based reasoning, revealing bottlenecks in tool coordination and reasoning under uncertainty. The authors position STQA as a rigorous testbed for future financial agent research.
cards.limitationsEn: The benchmark relies on template-based questions, limiting diversity of natural language; data is stock-specific, limiting generalizability. Evaluations are within the paper's scope, and generalization in real-world settings requires further validation.
cards.summary: 该研究介绍了STQA（股票聚焦表格问答）基准，基于大规模金融数据集，覆盖4417只股票，包含31,400个问答对，由专家模板生成，并带有意图和槽位标注。同时，作者提出了SQFRS系统，一个基于智能体的框架，统一编排SQL检索和时间序列预测工具。实验显示，当前大语言模型在历史查询上表现良好，但在基于预测的推理上存在明显挑战，暴露了工具协同和不确定性推理的瓶颈。作者认为STQA可作为金融智能体研究的测试平台。
cards.originalTitle: STQA: A Benchmark for Stock-Focused Tabular Question Answering over Historical and Forecasted Data
keyPointsEn: STQA covers 4,417 stocks and 31,400 QA pairs from expert templates with intent and slot annotations.
It includes historical queries, numerical forecasts, and forecast reasoning for comprehensive evaluation.
SQFRS integrates SQL and forecasting tools; experiments show forecast reasoning is a weakness for LLMs.
Reveals bottlenecks in tool coordination and uncertainty reasoning, guiding future work.

cards.title: 预算感知在线教学：提升网页智能体持续学习效率
cards.titleEn: Budget-Aware Online Teaching for Web Agents
cards.whyItMattersEn: The research offers a practical solution for deploying web agents under budget constraints, enabling lightweight models to learn efficiently from stronger teachers while balancing performance and cost.
keyPoints: 提出预算感知在线教学框架，解决网页智能体在线适应成本高的问题
通过可解性门控决定何时调用教师模型，优化教学时机
采用分数引导的回合选择，筛选信息量大的训练数据
在MiniWoB和TimeWarp实验中，教师调用减少22.6%，学生训练计算减少52.1%
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为在预算受限条件下部署网页智能体提供了实用方案，通过智能分配教学资源，使轻量级模型能够高效地从强教师模型学习，平衡了性能与成本。
cards.descriptionEn: This research addresses the high cost of continuous online adaptation for web agents in real-world deployment. It introduces a budget-aware framework that optimizes when to query the teacher and which data to train on, reducing teaching costs while maintaining performance.
cards.description: 该研究针对网页智能体部署后需要持续在线适应的问题，提出了一种预算感知的在线教学框架。该框架通过可解性门控和分数引导的回合选择机制，优化了教师模型调用的时机和训练数据的选择，从而在保持性能的同时显著降低教学成本。
cards.limitations: 实验主要在模拟环境MiniWoB和TimeWarp上进行，真实网络环境下的适应效果未知。学生模型性能虽相近，但教师调用的减少是否推广到不同任务和模型架构尚需验证。作者未报告方差或显著性检验。
cards.summaryEn: The study proposes a method that uses a solvability-aware gate and score-guided turn selection to reduce unnecessary teacher calls and choose informative training data. The authors argue this improves online adaptation efficiency under budget constraints.
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments were mainly conducted in simulated environments (MiniWoB and TimeWarp), and effectiveness in real web environments remains unknown. The gains in teacher call reduction may not generalize across tasks or model architectures. Authors did not report variance or significance tests.
cards.summary: 本研究提出实验方法，通过教师门控和回合筛选，减少不必要和冗余的教师调用，降低了在线教学成本。作者认为该方法能有效提升资源受限场景下智能体的适应效率。
cards.originalTitle: When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents
keyPointsEn: Introduces a budget-aware online teaching framework to reduce costs in web agent adaptation
Uses a solvability-aware gate to determine when to call the teacher model, optimizing timing
Employs score-guided turn selection to retain informative data for training
Reduces teacher calls by 22.6% and student training compute by 52.1% on MiniWoB and TimeWarp

cards.title: AI风险是否在美国股市定价？来自金融新闻因素的新证据
cards.titleEn: Are AI Risks Priced in U.S. Stocks? New Evidence from Financial News Factors
cards.whyItMattersEn: This paper fills an empirical gap in AI risk pricing, offering a new risk dimension for investors and policymakers, and highlights domain specificity.
keyPoints: 识别7787篇AI相关新闻，构建4种系统性风险因子
仅错误信息风险因子D3获得显著风险溢价
高减低组合月alpha为0.49%-0.57%
结果对多种控制变量和子样本稳健
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究填补了AI风险定价的实证空白，为投资者和政策制定者提供新的风险维度参考，且强调领域特异性。
cards.descriptionEn: This study constructs four AI risk factors from WSJ news using LDA and MIT taxonomy, finding that only misinformation risk carries a significant premium in U.S. equities.
cards.description: 本研究使用LDA和MIT AI风险仓库分类法，从华尔街日报新闻中构建四种AI风险因子，首次发现仅错误信息风险评估溢价显著。
cards.limitations: 样本限于华尔街日报，人工关键词和LDA可能引入噪音，AI风险快速演变导致分类滞后，研究方法依赖历史新闻，可能无法捕捉未报道风险。
cards.summaryEn: The author identifies 7,787 articles from 2016 to 2025, applies LDA and domain taxonomy to build factors, and tests pricing via portfolio sorts and Fama-MacBeth regressions, finding robust pricing only for the misinformation factor.
cards.limitationsEn: The sample is limited to WSJ articles, manual keywords and LDA may introduce noise, the rapid evolution of AI risks makes the taxonomy lag, and the method relies on historical news, potentially missing unreported risks.
cards.summary: 作者通过关键词筛选出2016-2025年间的7787篇文章，结合LDA和领域分类法构建因子，用组合分析和Fama-MacBeth回归测试定价，发现仅错误信息因子有显著溢价。
cards.originalTitle: Are AI Risks Priced in the U.S. Stock Market? Evidence from Financial News Factors
keyPointsEn: Identified 7,787 AI-related articles and built four systematic risk factors
Only the misinformation factor D3 shows a robust risk premium
High-minus-low beta portfolio earns monthly alpha of 0.49%-0.57%
Results are robust to various controls and subsamples

cards.title: Superpowers：一种智能体技能框架与软件开发方法学
cards.titleEn: Superpowers: An Agentic Skills Framework and Software Development Methodology
cards.whyItMattersEn: As AI-assisted programming becomes prevalent, systematic integration of agent capabilities is critical. Superpowers attempts to provide a structured framework that may help developers organize AI toolchains and improve collaboration, or spark discussion on AI development methodologies.
keyPoints: 提出智能体技能与软件开发结合的方法论
强调技能的可复用性和流程标准化
面向 AI 驱动的开发场景
cards.whyItMatters: 随着 AI 辅助编程普及，如何系统化整合智能体能力成为关键。Superpowers 尝试提供一种结构化框架，可能为开发者组织 AI 工具链、提升协作效率提供参考，或引发对 AI 开发方法论的讨论。
cards.descriptionEn: This project introduces a methodology combining AI agentic skills with software development processes, offering a structured framework for AI-driven development. It emphasizes reusability of skills and standardization of workflows to enhance efficiency and collaboration. For developers focused on AI programming practices and agent applications, this project provides a reference approach.
cards.description: 该项目提出一种将 AI 智能体技能与软件开发流程结合的方法论，为 AI 驱动的开发提供结构化框架。其新颖之处在于强调技能的可复用性和流程的标准化，旨在提升开发效率与协作性。对于关注 AI 编程实践和智能体应用的开发者，该项目提供了可参考的思路。
cards.limitations: 该信息仅基于 GitHub 仓库的简要描述，未提供实际应用案例、性能数据或社区反馈。项目仍处于早期阶段，其效果与适用性未经验证。
cards.summaryEn: According to the GitHub page description, Superpowers is an 'agentic skills framework & software development methodology' that claims to work. The author suggests the framework improves development workflows, but the page lacks implementation details or performance data.
cards.limitationsEn: Information is based solely on a brief description from the GitHub repository, without practical use cases, performance metrics, or community feedback. The project is likely early-stage, and its effectiveness and applicability are unverified.
cards.summary: 根据 GitHub 页面描述，Superpowers 是一个“智能体技能框架与软件开发方法学”，声称能有效工作。项目作者认为该框架能改善开发流程，但页面未提供具体实现细节或效果数据。
keyPointsEn: Presents a methodology integrating agentic skills with software development
Emphasizes skill reusability and workflow standardization
Designed for AI-driven development scenarios

cards.title: TradingAgents多智能体框架：探索LLM在金融交易中的应用
cards.titleEn: TradingAgents Framework: Exploring LLM-based Multi-Agent Financial Trading
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework demonstrates a novel application of LLMs in financial decision-making, attempting to reduce uncertainty from a single model through multi-role collaboration and debate, providing new tools and ideas for quantitative research. Its open-source nature encourages further community exploration and validation.
keyPoints: TradingAgents是用于金融交易的多智能体LLM框架，包含分析师、研究员、交易员、风控等角色。
框架引入多智能体辩论与反思机制，模拟人类交易团队的协作流程。
项目提供了完整的代码和示例，便于复现实验。
来源提到在股票回测中取得了正面结果（未提供具体数据）。
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架展示了LLM在金融决策中的新应用模式，通过多角色协作和辩论机制尝试降低单一模型的不确定性，为量化研究提供了新的工具和思路。同时其开源性质有助于社区进一步探索和验证。
cards.descriptionEn: This framework presents a multi-agent LLM approach to financial trading, simulating the collaborative workflow of analysts, researchers, traders, and risk managers in a real trading firm. The novelty is combining multiple agent roles with a debate mechanism to enhance decision reliability. It aims to provide a reproducible LLM trading experiment environment for quantitative research, enabling validation of different agent configurations.
cards.description: 该框架提出一种基于多智能体LLM的金融交易方法，模拟真实交易公司中分析师、研究员、交易员和风控人员的协作流程。新意在于将多种智能体角色结合并引入辩论机制，以提升交易决策的可靠性。该工具旨在为量化研究提供一种可复现的LLM交易实验环境，便于验证不同智能体设定对交易表现的影响。
cards.limitations: 未提供具体的回测数据、基准对比和统计显著性检验，因此无法验证其真实有效性。框架高度依赖LLM输出，存在幻觉风险，且未考虑真实交易中的成本、滑点和市场冲击。目前仅在单一数据源上测试，缺乏跨市场泛化证据。
cards.summaryEn: The content introduces an open-source framework called TradingAgents, which uses multiple LLM agents to simulate a financial trading team. It includes role division, debate, and reflection mechanisms, and was backtested on a specific stock dataset. The authors suggest it complements traditional quantitative strategies but acknowledge the risk of LLM hallucinations.
cards.limitationsEn: No specific backtest data, benchmark comparisons, or statistical significance tests are provided, so real effectiveness cannot be verified. The framework heavily relies on LLM outputs, posing hallucination risks, and does not account for real trading costs, slippage, or market impact. Currently only tested on a single data source, lacking cross-market generalization evidence.
cards.summary: 该内容介绍了一个名为TradingAgents的开源框架，利用多个大语言模型智能体模拟金融交易团队。框架包含角色分工、决策辩论和反思机制，并在特定股票数据集上进行了回测。作者认为该框架能与传统量化策略互补，但承认LLM存在幻觉风险。
keyPointsEn: TradingAgents is a multi-agent LLM framework for financial trading, including roles such as analyst, researcher, trader, and risk manager.
The framework introduces multi-agent debate and reflection to simulate human trading team collaboration.
The project provides complete code and examples for reproducibility.
The source mentions positive backtest results on stock data (no specific numbers).

cards.title: 面向 ADHD 开发者的编程助手技能：提升输出清晰度
cards.titleEn: AI Assistant Skill for ADHD Developers to Clarify Output
cards.whyItMattersEn: For developers with ADHD, verbose responses from AI tools can increase cognitive load. This project explores how optimizing output can enhance user experience, offering a new angle for personalized assistive tools.
keyPoints: 定位于提高编码辅助工具的输出清晰度
